blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — A 27-year-old businessman was arrested during e recent entrapment operation after he was allegedly caught selling unauthorized and unregistered cooking oil products in Barangay Baga-uma, Aroroy, Masbate. Police Lt. Col. Nino Lope Briones, director of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) in Bicol, said the suspect is a resident of Purok 6, Barangay Baga-uma. Briones said the operation, conducted on Nov. 19, under Oplan Megashopper, resulted in the confiscation of cooking oil products allegedly being sold in violation of Sections 11(a) and 11(k) of Republic Act No. 3720, as amended by Republic Act No. 9711, or the […]...
